Retain as a case/event-study candidate only; no causal label until pre-halt degradation, simultaneous NYSE American impairment, common news, and network spillovers are handled.

Closing-process issue after 17:30 CEST created invalid trades; the exact continuous-trading restart must use segment-specific schedule.

reason_as_stated: Technical issue in third-party middleware persistence system; Euronext states it was not a cyber-attack.
other_channels_status: Other Euronext segments were halted; Oslo Bors excepted. Whether economically matched non-Euronext venues/instruments were available is UNKNOWN from these sources.
foreknowledge: Unplanned system incident; exact participant/public knowledge timestamp before 09:48 is UNKNOWN. The market-status page is an operational update, not proof of zero anticipation.
contemporaneous_contamination: Severe closing-process contamination: trades after 17:30 CEST (17:28 Dublin) were cancelled except commodities, books reset, and vendors asked to realign corrected prices. This forbids naive closing-price/event-day outcomes.
data_or_clock_caveat: Use only valid trade lifecycle and segment-specific timestamp. Do not treat vendor stale/corrected closing prices as a market halt or use cancelled trades as observations.
